title.value: What if We Enrich day-ahead Solar Irradiance Time Series Forecasting with Spatio-Temporal Context?
title.justification: The provided title accurately corresponds to the content of the paper and its objective to enhance solar irradiance forecasting using spatio-temporal context.
title.quote: Title: What if We Enrich day-ahead Solar Irradiance Time Series Forecasting with Spatio-Temporal Context?

extractions.description: The paper discusses a deep learning architecture, CrossViViT, that uses spatio-temporal context from satellite data for accurate day-ahead solar irradiance forecasting, with a focus on Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI). The model includes a Multi-Quantile variant for uncertainty estimation and addresses solar power integration into the electrical grid, aiming to improve grid management and reduce reliance on fossil fuels. The study emphasizes the potential to mitigate climate change by optimizing solar power usage.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly addresses the impact of solar irradiance forecasting on climate change mitigation and the integration of solar power into the grid, highlighting its significance in reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
climate_change_is_central.quote: The global integration of solar power into the electrical grid could have a crucial impact on climate change mitigation, yet poses a challenge due to solar irradiance variability.
